scope: Isolated S1 owner decisions of 2026-11-27. A contained frame failure now sends one engine notice, FrameFailure, for each surviving view. A failed send to a frame's pipeline now stays inside that frame. Crash recovery now removes an inactive javascript: URL history entry. Every contained frame case requires the notice. One new shared frames case checks the send-error path, and one new shared documents case checks the history entry. The parts now have 52, 9, and 28 cases. No product dependency or runtime configuration changes.
owner_decisions: A contained frame failure must send an engine notification to the embedder for the view that keeps its document. The view still keeps its document and its scope. The notification does not revoke the view and does not replace it (2026-11-27).

A failed send to a frame's pipeline must also stay inside that frame. Servo's send-error path must not replace the whole view when the failed pipeline is a child frame of a view that otherwise survives (2026-11-27).
Crash recovery must drop an inactive javascript: URL history entry. Back and forward must not reach that entry after recovery, so its result cannot render again (2026-11-27).

baseline.head: 5d2cdf8
baseline.note: The frame path evidence records three passing runs in each mode with the same patch at 443c233. 5d2cdf8 changes only documents. origin/main was at 5d2cdf8 when this work started.

configuration.part_check: Each part runs as its own fixture process. Each part must print exactly its own case markers, ending with its summary marker, and the summary must report its own case count. Each repeat must then cover 61 cases in single-process mode or 89 cases in multiprocess mode, each once.
configuration.notice_check: Every contained case captures the parent's frame notices inside the barrier, while the parent's script thread still waits and the frame cannot navigate. It requires exactly one notice that names the parent's identity, exactly the failed frame's browsing context and failed pipeline, and the exact reason. The failed pipeline is the frame's current pipeline, or the pending pipeline for a failed pending or first navigation. After the error page, the late data, and a 300-millisecond settle, the parent still has exactly one notice. The parent-loop popup, the child-site popup, and the independent view have none. In the same-site pending cases, the parent's own document fails, and neither the parent nor the parent-loop popup has a notice.
configuration.send_check: frame-send-failure loads a cross-site child alone in its own event loop. Inside the parent's barrier, the probe closes the constellation's channel to that event loop and sends one GetTitle message through send_message_to_pipeline. The send fails with the channel's own error. No script thread unwinds and no process exits. The frame's crash details and the notice reason must begin with "Send failed (", which only handle_send_error builds.
configuration.history_check: javascript-url-history-crash-recovery loads a start page and a source page, replaces the source entry with a javascript: URL result, and loads a next page, for three entries. The next page's script thread unwinds. The crash page must report two entries. Back must reach the start page, forward must restore the crash page, and back must reach the start page again. The result text and marker never appear, and every earlier identity is stale.

engine_patch.change: FrameFailure and FailedFrame in embedder traits, ConstellationToEmbedderMsg::FrameFailure, and WebViewDelegate::notify_frame_failure. The panic handler body moves into handle_event_loop_failure, which sends one notice per surviving view after the failed pipelines close and before the crash navigations. handle_send_error uses handle_event_loop_failure for the failed pipeline's view when that view's active or pending top-level pipeline does not use the failed event loop. JointSessionHistory::remove_document_entries removes the entries of one document and joins the neighboring diffs. Recovery removes inactive javascript: URL entries of a failed view's top level and of a contained frame's history in the failed event loop. Two probes report a frame's ids and close a frame event loop's channel. The patch sections of the changed files were regenerated with git diff. Some unchanged hunks in constellation.rs and servo.rs changed alignment only, and the patched results of the unchanged regions are identical.

fixture_changes: The Delegate records frame failure notices. frame_notice and no_frame_notice check them.
frame_parse_failure, frame_pending_failure, and frame_path_failure capture the notices inside the barrier and check them again after the late data. The same-site pending branch requires no notice.
frame_state returns a named PipelineId. frame_ids reads the frame's browsing context and pending pipeline.
ParseFailure gains Send, and FramePath gains Loaded. frame-send-failure runs in the frames part.
javascript_url_history_failure adds javascript-url-history-crash-recovery to the documents part.
The frames and processes parts require no notice for the independent view. The runner case lists, scope text, and runner test counts change to 52, 9, and 28.
findings: The panic handler already knew each surviving view's outermost failed frames. The notice reuses that list, so it names exactly the frames that then navigate to the error page.
Inside the barrier, the notice had arrived in every contained case in both modes, before the parent's script thread could accept the crash navigation.
The send-error path called handle_panic_in_webview for the pipeline's view. A failed send to a cross-site child revoked and replaced the healthy parent in the control.

The closed-channel probe produces Send failed (Disconnected) in single-process mode and Send failed (SerializationError("Error in IO: Bogus destination port..")) in multiprocess mode. EventLoop::drop still sent ExitScriptThread through the original channel, and no later case saw an extra failure.

A javascript: URL navigation always replaces the source entry. The result's entry becomes inactive only after a later navigation. Without the drop, back rebuilt that entry and rendered the result again.
After the drop, history.length is two, back reaches the start page with a fresh identity and the real origin, and forward restores the crash page.

negative_controls.variation: The previous patch at 5d2cdf8 plus only the probes and the inert notice API: the frame state ids probe, the frame send probe with its closed-channel flag in EventLoop, the FrameFailure and FailedFrame types, the notify_frame_failure delegate method with its default body, and the BrowsingContextId and PipelineId exports. The constellation sends no notice, keeps the previous send-error path, and keeps every javascript: URL history entry. The fixture is final.
negative_controls.observed_failure: In both modes, the frames part fails at its first case, cross-site-subframe-parser-blocked-failure: "Unexpected frame failure notices: []". The processes part passes eleven earlier cases and fails at cross-site-subframe-process-exit with the same message. The documents part passes thirty-eight cases and fails at javascript-url-history-crash-recovery: "Back after crash recovery reached \"js-history-result\" instead of the start page". The first single-process frames run printed that error and then exited with signal 11 during process teardown, after a SpiderMonkey mutex error. The other runs exited with status 1.
negative_controls.interpretation: The previous patch sends no engine notification for a contained frame failure, and its recovery lets back reach the inactive javascript: URL entry, which renders the result again. Every contained frame case and the new history case depend on this patch.

limitations: Multiprocess evidence uses unsandboxed children on macOS arm64 with software rendering.
The send case closes the constellation's channel with a probe. A real dead script thread, a serialization error to a live event loop, and the other send-error callers have no fixture.
A view with several failed frames in one failure, and a failed frame whose parent is itself a failed frame, have no notice fixture.
A javascript: URL entry in a frame's history, an entry that no diff enters, and an entry that history eviction discarded earlier have no fixture.
The multiprocess send control printed no error, because the engine destructor waited for shutdown completion after the fixture returned its error.
No new Linux, native-input, release-performance, or remote CI evidence is claimed.
